# Judith Chapter 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Judith 10 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/JDT_010_page_001.jpg

---

**10:1** And it-came-to-pass, when she-had-ceased crying-out to-the God of Israel and had-finished all these words,

**10:2** that she-arose from-upon her-face and called her-maidservant and went-down into the-house and put-off from-herself the-sackcloth and took-off the-garments of her-widowhood.

**10:3** And she-washed her-body with water and anointed herself with rich myrrh and plaited the-hairs of her-head and set a-tiara upon it and put-on the-garments of her-gladness, with which she-had-been-dressed in-the days of the-life of her-husband Manasseh.

**10:4** And she-put sandals on her-feet and she-put-on the-ankle-rings and the-bracelets and the-rings and the-earrings and all her-adornments, and she-made-herself very beautiful, for-the-purpose-of deceiving the-eyes of all the-men who-would-see her.

**10:5** And she-gave to her-maidservant a-skin of wine and a-jug of oil and filled a-bag with roasted-grain and a-cake of dried-figs and fine-breads, and she-wrapped all her-utensils together and placed them upon her.

**10:6** And they-went-out to-the gate of-the city of Bethulia and found standing there Uzziah and the-elders of-the city, Chabris and Charmis.

**10:7** And when they-saw her, that her-face was-changed and her-clothing was-changed, they-were-amazed exceedingly at her-beauty and said to-her:

**10:8** "May the-God of our-fathers give you-grace and accomplish your-plan for-the glory of-the sons of Israel and for-the exaltation of Jerusalem." And she-worshiped God.

**10:9** And she-said to-them: "Command [them] to-open for-me the-gate of-the city." And they-commanded the-young-men to-open for-her, as she-said.

**10:10** And they-did-so. And Judith went-out, she and her-maidservant with her. And the-men of-the city watched her until she-went-down the-mountain, until she-passed-through the-valley, and they-were-no-longer-able to-see her.

**10:11** And they-were-going through the-valley, and a-patrol of-the Assyrians met her.

**10:12** And they-seized her and asked her: "Of which people are you and from-where are you-coming and where are you-going?" And she-said: "I am a daughter of-the Hebrews, and I am-fleeing from before them, for they are-about to-be-given to you for-plunder.

**10:13** And I am-coming before Holofernes the-chief-general of your-force, to-report true words, and I-will-show him a-way by which he-will-go and seize all the-hill-country without losing one man or one life from his-force."

**10:14** And when the-men heard her-words and gazed upon her-face — and she-was wonderfully-beautiful in their-sight — they-said to-her:

**10:15** "You have-saved your-life by-hastening-down to-come before our-lord. And now approach his-tent. Some of-us will-escort you until they-deliver you into his-hands.

**10:16** And when you-stand before him, do not be-afraid in your-heart — for you-will-tell him according-to your-words, and he-will-treat-you well."

**10:17** And they-chose from-among them a-hundred men and they-placed her and her-maidservant with them, and they-brought them to-the tent of Holofernes.

**10:18** And there-was a-commotion throughout all the-camp, for her-arrival was-announced-from-tent-to-tent, and they-came and surrounded her as-she-stood outside the-tent of Holofernes, while they-were-announcing her.

**10:19** And they-were-marveling at her-beauty and were-marveling at the-sons of Israel because of her, and each-man said to-his-companion: "Who can-despise this people who have women-of-such-kind among-them? For it-is-not-good to-leave even one man of-them alive — for those-who-are-released would-be-able to-deceive all the-earth."

**10:20** And those-who-were-sleeping beside Holofernes, and all his-attendants, went-out and led her into the-tent.

**10:21** And Holofernes was-resting on his-bed under a-canopy, which was-woven from purple and gold and emeralds and precious-stones.

**10:22** And they-announced to-him concerning her, and he-came-out into the-fore-tent. And to-him silver lamps were-going-before [him].

**10:23** And when Judith came-before him and before his-servants, they-all-marveled at the-beauty of her-face. And she-fell-down upon her-face before him and his-servants raised her up.
